description:
It's time to throw it back to the 90's in Nash!

We are located right off West End, a highly sought out quiet neighborhood, close to all highways, downtown + lots of places to eat + explore. Check out the parthenon! 6 minutes to downtown! 4 minutes to midtown!
This is a very peaceful and quiet residential area

*please note these townhomes are not new builds, they are from the late 80s and hold some character still from then!

The space
Our fav 90's nostaglia brought to life!

Poster's hung up middle school style, bright colors, Saved by the Bell design mixed with a selfie wall throwing it back to large cell phones + Slater's Slating:)

->full kitchen
->living area with two futons and a twin bed
->4 seater dining
->1/2 bath
->outdoor patio

2nd floor:
->two queen bedrooms each with an ensuite RENOVATED bathroom!
